subject.title: Feature Request: Token Usage API for session_status Tool

question: Should OpenClaw expose raw token, cost, quota-window, and freshness/source metadata through `session_status.details.usage`, or should this become a separate agent-facing usage tool/API?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but the stable response shape, privacy boundary, and quota/freshness semantics are public API and product choices rather than a narrow bug repair.

options.title: Extend session_status details
options.body: Add a stable optional `details.usage` contract to the existing tool while preserving rendered status text and current visibility checks.

options.title: Create a separate usage tool
options.body: Keep `session_status` display-oriented and add a narrower agent-facing usage query surface backed by the existing gateway/transcript usage code.

options.title: Keep raw usage out of agent tools
options.body: Document that agents should use existing status display and gateway/operator surfaces while raw usage remains unavailable through `session_status`.

recommendation.title: Extend session_status details
recommendation.body: Add a stable optional `details.usage` contract to the existing tool while preserving rendered status text and current visibility checks.

likelyOwner.reason: He introduced the tool and has already framed the unresolved API/product decision in prior review context.
